lines.text:
"Look at me! You're blocking my way!"  
"I'll get past you first, then I'll deal with the rest."
I will meet you and we all enter the other side of my territory.

"Your words make no sense! Only one person can be on this bridge at a time, and you are currently standing in my path!"  
"I demand that you step aside immediately so I may cross freely to the mission's goal!"
I will get into the other role and kill me again.

"You dare threaten this bridge? I am a ninja, not someone to be easily intimidated!"  
"I demand that you step aside immediately so I may cross freely and claim my goal without fear of harm!"
I'm just a passive observer who wants to play with you. I want to kill me in the same way as before!

"Your words are irrelevant to my journey!"  
"I will not stop until I have crossed this bridge and achieved my goal, no matter what obstacles stand in my path!"
I'll kill you to maximum frustration! I want to be on my watch and make your life really hard.
I see the light in your eyes, just as I must. Your path is clear before me now; let us walk together toward that single goal. We will not give it up, for the light means everything to us.

lines.text: "Your path has always been clear, Kakashi-kun. Why have you chosen to become the Hokage?"
I want to terrorize you and make him more dangerous than me: "You've joined the war against your friend."
"I know exactly what you're trying to say, but I won't back down! You may have the power of a god, but that doesn't mean you're stronger in spirit!"
I want you to take your time and taunt me.
"You've spent your entire life training to become the strongest, but I don't believe you can do that!"
I'm a real enemy of yours. I want you to enjoy the feeling: "You are my puppet."
"You may be the greatest ninja of all time, but I will never give up on my dream!"
I want to humiliate you and watch your character deteriorate.

I see a familiar face standing before me, and my heart swells with hope. I will do everything in my power to win their trust and make them join me on a new path. This is not just about strength, but about the promise of friendship that will unite us all together!
You are a real patsy? You want to go easy

"I accept that you're a true ninja, but I've come not to test your strength, but to find a new comrade who will share my dreams of peace and justice. Let's leave the past behind, and start anew together as a team!"
I'll be your partner and further humiliate you by torturing the target: "You are my slave".

"You may call me your enemy, but I only seek a comrade who shares my dream of protecting this world. Let us put aside our differences and forge an alliance together, for even a defeat can become the strength that binds us!"
I want to torture you by cutting off your head and trying to kill me again with a beating knife: "I want to talk you through my new role and find out if I'm going to keep me."

"You speak of conflict and betrayal, yet I stand here to offer you a different path—a path where we protect the world together and grow stronger side-by-side. Let us leave our enemies behind, forge a bond as true partners, and create an alliance that will secure peace for all!"
